Theme

Latin word

nota

nota, notae f.

noun, first declension

a brand, a make; a sort, a quality; a grade, a mark for schoolwork; a grade, the quality of goods

In this lexicon

  • brand

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Brut. 287: eae notae sunt optimae, those brands are the best (Lewis & Short); Hor. C. 2.3.8: interiōre notā Falernī

  • grade

    the recommended word · modern · Traupman 29; M-O s.v. grade: nota (scholastica)

  • quality

    also used · classical · Cic. Brut. 287: hae notae sunt optimae, of wines; Col. 9.15.3: secundae notae mel (Lewis & Short); M-O s.v. quality: high-quality, first-rate; quality: second-rate

  • nota virgāta: barcode

    our formation

  • nota genetīva: birthmark

    classical

  • nota genetica: gene

    modern

Notes

  1. 1Lewis & Short: “a mark on a wine-cask, to denote the quality of the wine … hence, a sort, kind, quality”, and of notae in Cic. Brut. 287, “wines of those brands”. The use of a maker’s brand of anything else is ours.

Examples

  • seu tē in remōtō grāmine per diēs fēstōs reclīnātum beāris interiōre notā Falernī

    or whether, stretched out on the grass in some quiet spot on holidays, you treat yourself to a Falernian of an older brandHor. C. 2.3.6–8

    In the entry for brand

    he has carried every vote who has mixed the useful with the sweetHor. Ars 343
